status_at_definition: After discovery/external evidence comparison; before complete confirmation/randKO/nomination outputs.
rationale: Target-relative discovery reduced discovery-fold reproducibility and genetic support. Retain every tested program from both definitions and account for the expanded search family.
multiple_testing: BH over concatenated program records for gene decoys, protein decoys and primary-meta genetics; brain BH over concatenated programs and both disease directions; retain identical gene sets with distinct source records conservatively.
thresholds: Unchanged technical, 4/5 confirmation, 0.75 monotonicity, gene-decoy q<=0.05, protein percentile>=0.95, brain q<=0.05 plus directions, independent direction, and A genetic q<=0.05.
ranking: Same original tier, confirmation fraction, protein-decoy q, gene-decoy q, brain q, protein rho; no new weights.
interpretation: Pooled-family exploratory nomination after the program-definition comparison; original frozen branches and their outcomes remain available.
primary_GWAS: Author-combined GP2/Leonard meta-analysis only; overlapping cohort results retained as sensitivities.
